name: Buddhishan Manamperi
bio:
Buddhishan is an undergraduate at University of Moratuwa - Sri Lanka studying Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering and is currently working at the Augmented Human Lab as a research intern.

He always tries to involve in innovative and self-learning projects related to IoT & Wearable devices and to enhance experience & knowledge while actively contributing through his engineering skills and creativity to be a responsible team player.

He loves a simple lifestyle.
